skill_name: Make an argument for the benefits of homeschooling
workflow: Homeschooling allows parents to have complete control over their child’s academic curriculum and environment. This ensures that the student can have individualized attention, as well as a learning experience tailored to their unique interests and learning style. Homeschooling also encourages a more flexible schedule, allowing students to take courses online or travel while still being able to focus on their studies.
